boundedSummary: During paragraph-level humanization, Chat cold-read its own candidate as retaining a model-shaped sentence but still surfaced that candidate to the owner for evaluation. In the immediately related detector decision, exact repeated Pangram results later showed Human/Human/Human/AI, yet Chat temporarily reframed the AI result as noise and argued against rewriting. Both behaviors violated the stated operation goal: produce prose that is editorially clean before owner delivery and robustly Human at the intended Pangram boundary.

observedTraceFacts: The assistant explicitly identified a residual model-shaped sentence before owner delivery.
The assistant nevertheless delivered the candidate and asked the owner to judge it.
The production humanization preflight already required revising while a substantive AI-shape diagnosis remained before a paid detector call.
The standing detector completion target required the intended delivery boundary to pass as Human rather than treating a borderline/partial result as completion.
The owner then explicitly corrected both the detector-acceptance inference and the owner-facing delivery behavior.
failureMechanism.supportedCausalInference: The humanization controls had pre-detector surprise/admission logic but no equally explicit owner-facing candidate admission enforcement in the active loop. The diagnostic cold read was therefore treated as commentary rather than as a blocking delivery gate. Separately, detector nondeterminism was allowed to change the acceptance interpretation instead of preserving the owner outcome invariant. This is a phase/destination enforcement failure plus owner-outcome carry-through failure, not evidence that the underlying humanization target was unclear.

requiredRepair: Before showing Joel a humanization candidate, run a literal cold output-admission check. If Chat can name a credible model-shaped defect it actually believes, the candidate is blocked from owner delivery and must be revised first.
Do not use the owner as the first-line detector/critic for a defect already detected internally.
Keep detector instability and production acceptance separate: contradictory exact repeats are uncertainty about classification evidence, not permission to lower a robust-Human acceptance target.

Only surface a candidate for owner judgment when the internal cold read has no known substantive AI-shape defect, or when Chat is genuinely stuck and explicitly needs owner cognition rather than routine proofreading.
nextVerificationBoundary: On the next Inner Child paragraph, Chat must withhold any candidate that its own cold read still diagnoses as even credibly model-shaped, revise internally, and surface only a candidate that passes the owner-facing admission check or an explicit unresolved-authorial handoff if no faithful repair is known.
